Latest: Amazon's 2026 Fall Prime Day deals are wrapping up at midnight Pacific Time—last chance to snag your favorites.

Amazon's 2026 Fall Prime Day sale is in full swing with discounts on millions of items, including one of the lowest prices ever on AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and up to $150 off the all-new M6 Mac mini lineup—an all-time low. Beyond those deals, the new Mac Studio is nearly $200 off, while the M5 MacBook Air lineup is $200 off, with nearly every configuration near a recent low.

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 lineup has debuted at its lowest price ever, with the Ultra 4 also down nearly $100; alongside the first deals on Apple's all-new Magic Keyboard and the 2026 iPhone 18 Pro case lineup. Keep reading for more on Fall Prime Day deals across chargers, accessories, power stations, e-bikes, apparel, and more.
